title: Guidance miss, audit probe could spell rough day for Hain Celestial stock
主要内容: Hain Celestial Group experienced a significant drop in its stock price on Tuesday, with shares plunging 27 percent after the company delayed the release of its fiscal 2016 financial results, missed guidance, and announced potential accounting concerns. The stock is on track for its worst day in history, having already lost $1.6 billion in market cap. The company identified concessions granted to certain U.S. distributors during its fiscal fourth quarter ended in June and is evaluating whether the revenue associated with these concessions was recorded in the correct period. The company also mentioned it is reviewing its internal control over financial reporting. Analysts have mixed reactions, with some calling the drop a potential buying opportunity, while others have downgraded the stock. Hain has not disclosed the names of the distributors in question and has postponed releasing its financial results until an audit committee review is completed. The company had previously forecast sales between $2.95 billion and $2.97 billion and earnings per share between $2 and $2.04, but now expects to miss these targets. Analysts like Amit Sharma believe the company's position in the health and wellness sector remains strong, while others like Phil Terpolilli suggest the accounting issues could take six to 12 months to resolve. The stock of Hain Celestial may face a challenging day due to a guidance miss and an ongoing audit probe. Analysts have expressed concerns, with one stating there are currently 'more questions than answers.' The analyst, Phil Lazar, mentioned that while it is not typically their preference to downgrade a stock on a day when it is expected to be weak, the uncertainty surrounding the potential outcomes and time frame of the review has led them to take this course of action. Lazar also noted that there is no guarantee the outcome will be materially unfavorable, and it could simply be a matter of timing. The article was revised to correct the spelling of Phil Terpolilli's last name.
